scripts.dev: node scripts/build-electron.mjs && concurrently --kill-others --success first --names renderer,electron "ng serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173" "wait-on --timeout 15000 http://127.0.0.1:5173/ && cross-env NICE_AUDIO_PLAYER_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: cargo run --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --bin generate-bindings && node scripts/fonts.mjs check && ng build && node scripts/build-electron.mjs && cargo build --release --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml && node scripts/stage-backend.mjs && node scripts/stage-runtime.mjs
scripts.test: ng test --watch=false && playwright test --project=renderer && node scripts/build-electron.mjs && playwright test --project=electron && cargo test --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml
scripts.validate: cargo run --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --bin generate-bindings -- --check && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && ng build --configuration development && prettier . --check && pnpm lint && cargo fmt --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && pnpm test && pnpm build
